## Valencia Rentals That Pass Your Hard Filters
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- **2 of 6 listings** meet every hard constraint: **#1 Benimaclet Bright Flat** and **#4 Algirós Terrace**.
- **Best overall:** **#1 Benimaclet Bright Flat**.
- Constraints that did **not** eliminate any listing: **cats allowed**, **lease term at least 11 months**, and **max 35 minutes to UPV**.

## Cost Basis Used

- I treated a deposit of “1 month” or “2 months” as that many months of the listing’s stated **monthly housing cost including community fees**, since no separate rent-only deposit basis was provided.

## Best Pick: Benimaclet Bright Flat
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- **Recommended listing:** **#1 Benimaclet Bright Flat**
- Why it wins:
  - **Lowest move-in cost** among valid matches: **€2,560**
  - **Under budget** monthly at **€1,280 including fees**
  - **2 bedrooms**, **furnished**, **cats allowed**
  - **No agency fee**
  - **12-month lease**
  - **28-minute** public-transit commute to **Universitat Politècnica de València**

- **Runner-up:** **#4 Algirós Terrace**
  - Valid, but much weaker on upfront cash because the **2-month deposit** pushes move-in cost to **€3,990**.

If you want the strict lowest-cost choice that satisfies everything, **go with Benimaclet Bright Flat**.

## Best Double Feature for a Fun-but-Smart Night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg

- **Best pair:** **Knives Out** + **Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse**
- **Watch order:** **Knives Out** → **20-minute break** → **Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse**
- **Total time:** **268 minutes (4h 28m)**, which is **17 minutes under** your 4h 45m limit
- **Why this wins:** It gives you the strongest mix of clever mystery, upbeat energy, English-language accessibility, and low-gore crowd appeal without tipping into heavy romance or emotionally draining territory.
- **Why this order works:** Start with the denser, clue-heavy whodunit while everyone is fresh, then end with the most kinetic, colorful, feel-good movie of the shortlist.

## Movie-by-Movie Fit Check
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

| Film | Runtime | Language | Constraint Fit | Vibe Match | Verdict |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Knives Out | 131 min | English | Low violence; light emotional weight | Witty, clever mystery-comedy | **Pick** |
| The Martian | 144 min | English | Low violence; uplifting | Smart, optimistic sci-fi | Strong alternate |
| Arrival | 116 min | English | Low violence; more serious tone | Smart but subdued | Not chosen |
| Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse | 117 min | English | Stylized violence; upbeat | Inventive, energetic, very fun | **Pick** |
| Palm Springs | 90 min | English | Low violence; romance more central | Playful, lighter-weight cleverness | Not chosen |
| Train to Busan | 118 min | Korean | High violence; subtitles; intense | Too stressful/gory for brief | Not chosen |
| Game Night | 100 min | English | Mild violence; easy watch | Funny, chaotic mystery-comedy | Good backup |

## Why the Other Five Didn’t Make the Cut
- **The Martian** — It is the best backup, but its 144-minute runtime blocks the ideal pairing with Knives Out and loses to the tighter, more varied winner.
- **Arrival** — It is intelligent and excellent, but its thoughtful, serious mood is less upbeat than the “fun but smart” tone you want.
- **Palm Springs** — It is breezy and entertaining, but the romance angle is more central than your group seems to want tonight.
- **Train to Busan** — It misses on three constraints at once: subtitles, high gore, and a much more intense emotional experience.
- **Game Night** — It is a solid fallback, but it leans broader and more chaotic than clever compared with the two selected films.

## Snack Ideas That Match the Vibe
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- **Truffle black-pepper popcorn** — feels a little sharp and upscale, which fits the Knives Out half of the night.
- **Mini sliders or bao buns** — satisfying enough for the break without becoming a heavy dinner situation.
- **Dark chocolate + sour citrus gummies** — a smart mix of sleek and playful, which matches the double feature perfectly.

## Best Match for Your Flights and Work Calls
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg

- I ranked these for **comfort over 6+ hours → mic quality → ANC → sound**, with **$320 max** and **Bluetooth multipoint for iPhone + Windows** treated as must-haves.
- For your device mix, **reliable multipoint matters more than codec differences**.
- **Best overall:** Bose QuietComfort 2023
- **Best value:** Soundcore Space One Pro

## Ranked Headphone Comparison
| Rank | Model | Price | Comfort | Mic | ANC | Sound | Weight / Battery | Multipoint | Fit for your use |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bose QuietComfort 2023 | $299 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 240g / 24h ANC | Yes | Best all-around for long wear, calls, and travel |
| 2 | Sony WH-1000XM4 | $279 | 8/10 | 7/10 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 254g / 30h ANC | Yes | Strong runner-up with better battery |
| 3 | Soundcore Space One Pro | $199 | 8/10 | 7/10 | 7/10 | 7/10 | 290g / 40h ANC | Yes | Best savings without missing key features |
| 4 | Sennheiser Accentum Plus | $229 | 8/10 | 6/10 | 7/10 | 8/10 | 227g / 50h ANC | Yes | Great battery, but weaker mic hurts office use |
| 5 | Apple AirPods Max | $479 | 7/10 | 8/10 | 9/10 | 9/10 | 385g / 20h ANC | Limited | Over budget and not ideal for iPhone + Windows |

- **Why Sennheiser falls to #4:** excellent battery and low weight, but the **6/10 mic** is the weakest here, which matters a lot for office calls.
- **Why AirPods Max is last:** it breaks your budget and its cross-platform multipoint behavior is weaker for **iPhone + Windows** use.

## Top 3 Trade-offs
Option 1: **Bose QuietComfort 2023** | Best fit for your exact priorities | Comfort 9/10; Mic 8/10; ANC 9/10
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/laptop.svg
- The strongest combo of **all-day comfort**, **clear call quality**, and **top-tier ANC**.
- Main trade-off: **24h battery** is lower than Sony/Soundcore, but still enough for long-haul travel and office use.

Option 2: **Sony WH-1000XM4** | Best premium alternative | ANC 9/10; 30h battery; Multipoint yes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- Very balanced and still excellent for flights.
- Main trade-off: it trails Bose on **comfort** and **mic quality**, which are your top two priorities.

Option 3: **Soundcore Space One Pro** | Best bang for the buck | $199; 40h battery; Multipoint yes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- Big savings while still giving you **good comfort**, **usable call quality**, and long battery life.
- Main trade-off: **ANC and overall refinement** are a clear step down from Bose and Sony, and it is the **heaviest** of the in-budget finalists.

## Final Choice for You
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- **Best overall pick: Bose QuietComfort 2023**
- **Best value pick under your budget: Soundcore Space One Pro**

If I were choosing for your stated priorities, I’d buy the **Bose QuietComfort 2023**. It is the cleanest match for **6+ hour comfort**, **video-call mic quality**, and **strong ANC**, while still fitting your budget and multipoint requirement.

Pick the **Soundcore Space One Pro** instead only if saving about **$100** matters more than getting the last step up in comfort, call quality, and ANC. The **Sony WH-1000XM4** is the middle-ground alternative, but Bose is the better buy for only **$20 more**.
